candidates.funder: London Borough of Newham (administered with Genting Casino)
candidates.title: Genting Good Causes Fund 2025/26
candidates.round_history: Opened 9 Feb 2026, closed 8 Mar 2026. Annual cycle.
candidates.notes: Up to £5,000 for not-for-profits, voluntary, community and faith groups, schools and charities based in Newham.

candidates.title: Neighbourhood Small Grants Programme
candidates.notes: £10,000 allocated per neighbourhood with grants up to £1,000 each. Small/emerging/local community groups.

candidates.title: Croydon Community Grant Fund
candidates.notes: Two-stage: bid first for up to £1,000, then successful groups can bid again for up to £5,000.

candidates.title: One Croydon Alliance Community Funding
candidates.notes: Funds local voluntary and community groups for projects reducing social isolation and loneliness. Recurrent + one-off available.

candidates.title: Westminster Community Contribution Fund
candidates.round_history: Eligibility quiz open 27 Feb – 27 Mar 2026; applications due 3 Apr 2026.
candidates.notes: Annual cycle. Find current amounts on the guidelines page.

candidates.title: Westminster Community Fund
candidates.notes: Up to £25,000. Themes: young people reaching potential, rough sleeping, social isolation/loneliness.

candidates.funder: Havering Together (£250k from City Bridge Foundation)
candidates.title: Havering Together
candidates.notes: Borough-wide giving initiative funded by City Bridge. Aims to unlock funding for grassroots Havering initiatives. Verify whether catalogue should list this as its own programme or as a backer of the existing Havering Community Chest.

candidates.title: Fellowship Fund
candidates.notes: Two streams: collaboration grants up to £9,500 (4-6 orgs together); development grants up to £2,000. Activities May 2026 – Mar 2027.

candidates.title: Central Grants Programme — Stronger Communities
candidates.notes: Rolling programme, no deadline. Small Grants scheme for £3,000 or less; minimum £500. Decisions within 8-12 weeks. Applies to City of London + housing estates City Corp runs in wider London.

candidates.title: Community Radio Fund
candidates.round_history: 2025-26 round closed 5 Oct 2025; awards announced Feb 2026 (47 stations, total £1.004m, range £7.5k–£39.8k). Historically two rounds/year; 2025-26 ran a single combined round.
